source_note: 为避免把被树木与拜殿遮挡的大殿作无据复原，改选同一古迹范围内有完整正面实拍的千秋鉴舞楼。Gary Todd 2010 年照片为 CC0，图中匾额可明确识别千秋鉴。
prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: a single fine-line architectural illustration for the Chinese heritage collection 访古.
Image 1 is the STYLE MASTER, an existing Vairocana Buddha contour drawing. Match its elegant, delicate, slightly organic thin lines, restrained detail, generous blank areas, and consistent visual density. Image 2 (and subsequent photos if applicable) is SUBJECT GEOMETRY ONLY: draw the actual named monument in that reference, preserving its identifying silhouette, roof type, visible storey count, bay count, openings, and proportions.
Create a refined, sparse BLACK INK ON PURE WHITE line drawing. Use confident fine contours with a few finer internal structural lines. All surfaces remain WHITE; use outlines for doors and windows rather than dark fills. No solid shadows, no broad grey shading, no crosshatching, no pencil grain, no texture, no gradient. No color, no gold, no black background. The white will become transparent and the ink the relevant dynasty color in the website.
Show the complete monument, centered, approximately straight-on at facade level, with verticals vertical and minimal perspective. Use only a few short ground lines. Remove tourists, foliage, vehicles, wires, modern signage, fences obstructing the structure, neighboring distractions and sky. Preserve architectural ornament selectively, without filling every roof tile or brick. No invented features. No labels, letters, calligraphy, dimension lines, captions, watermark, frame or border.
Wide compositions: landscape 1536×1024, entire building occupies about 82% of canvas width, roof/apex and base uncut, balanced breathing room. Tall pagodas: portrait 1024×1536, entire pagoda occupies about 82% of height, centred with equal side margins, apex and base uncut.


SUBJECT-SPECIFIC INSTRUCTIONS:
Draw ONLY the actual Qianqiujian Opera Stage 千秋鉴舞楼 opposite Guanlin Shrine in Luoyang 洛阳关林, built in 1791, as fully visible in photograph 2. This is the specific complete building in the photo, not Guanlin main hall. Preserve its highly distinctive silhouette: a narrow elevated central upper hipped-gable roof, a much broader lower hipped-gable projecting front roof, and the lower rear hard-gable house showing at the two sides. These combine as a two-eave central theater with lower side shoulders, not a generic three-storey pagoda. The main projecting stage front has THREE broad openings delineated by FOUR tall front columns; one further closed lattice-door side bay sits at each side behind, five facade bays overall. Preserve the tall rectangular masonry stage base, the pair of side access stairs climbing along the outside ends, and two tall shallow buttresses/support patches in the front wall of the high base. NO broad central staircase: the real photo has a tall solid flat front stage platform. Below upper roof, keep the broad EMPTY nameboard with no text. Keep central multi-part finial, roof-end beasts and a few delicate bracket shapes as fine contours, but simplify them greatly. Entire roof planes completely WHITE with only five short tile indications near edges; DO NOT draw repeated roof-tile grids or dense parallel vertical tile lines. Walls white, no brick grid. Retain only sparse rectangular lattice pattern in side window panels. Remove all lettering, nearby buildings, bushes, fence, modern paving and people. Level frontal view, symmetrical proportions faithful to photo, whole building including finial and base within generous 10 percent white margins, landscape 1536x1024.

site_recommendation.name: 洛阳关林
site_recommendation.yearNote: 图版选千秋鉴舞楼，按其 1791 年营建断代；关林殿群明万历年间沿革不用于此舞楼配色。
site_recommendation.place: 河南 · 洛阳市洛龙区
site_recommendation.coordinate_note: 维基百科关林古迹公开点位，代表整个关林范围；所绘舞楼在大门对面广场南侧，点位不宣称为舞楼单体测绘中心。
site_recommendation.lede: 高台上的千秋鉴舞楼，正对关林大门。前台歇山与后台硬山叠合，留下清代祭祀戏曲空间的鲜明轮廓。

facts.label: 所绘舞楼
facts.text: 舞楼又名千秋鉴，建于清乾隆五十六年（1791），与关林大门隔广场相对。

facts.label: 复合屋顶
facts.text: 舞楼平面作凸字形，前台歇山、后台硬山结合，形成宛如重檐楼阁的外观。

facts.label: 关林格局
facts.text: 关林以祠庙、墓冢等共同构成中轴线院落，现存建筑含明清多阶段遗构；本图仅取舞楼，不拆分重复入库。
